setup_restart_required.title: Restart required
setup_restart_required.description:
One or more integrations have been installed during setup. Home Assistant must be restarted for the changes to take effect.

Go to Settings → System → Restart to restart Home Assistant.

access_stopped.title: Access to {owner}/{repo} stopped
access_stopped.description:
Access to {owner}/{repo} was stopped. Ask your installer for a new key.

The installed version keeps working; updates resume when access comes back.

install_app.name: Install app
install_app.description: Install or update an app (add-on) from the Apps / PrivateApps store, the same way the Apps tab does. Sets up the YidStore Connector first if needed and returns when Home Assistant has finished installing it.

app_id.name: App ID
app_id.description: The app id from the Auto-Install list or the Apps list. Use this, or owner and repo.

repo.name: Repo
repo.description: The app's repository name (together with owner).

update.name: Update
update.description: Update the app if it is already installed. If off and the app is installed, nothing is done.
